title: A cue beyond sight
hook: Some snakes can detect heat-related cues.

knows: Animals have body structures and interact with their surroundings.
doesNotKnow: In the schematic, a warm target sends infrared cues toward a pit-bearing snake. Pit organs occur in some snakes, not all, and the illustration does not claim to reproduce the animal’s subjective visual experience.

misconception: The observed arrangement has a different effect than the one shown.
objective: A warm object and cooler surroundings are shown. What can infrared-sensitive pits help some snakes detect?
